note.ja: 再構成・直交性・特異値・右辺摂動による解差・最小二乗停留残差・厳密階数2の対照を保存します。高精度参照は実二進入力を整数比へ変換し、mpmath 1.3.0のSVDとQRを独立実行済みです。SHAと全4入力・両精度の完全性を実行時に検査し、不一致を解析解へ置換しません。
note.en: Save reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, solution perturbations, least-squares stationarity and an exact rank-two control. The mpmath1.3.0 SVD and QR reference was actually executed using integer-ratio conversions of binary inputs. Runtime SHA and completeness guards check all four inputs at both precisions and never substitute analytic truth after a mismatch.
